summary.rule: test and exam windows only; N split equally between the two exams, then evenly per predicted cluster (a cluster smaller than its share gives all it has); weight = the stratum's windows / the windows drawn from it; a fraction shown twice, at least a quarter of the queue apart; the order a seeded shuffle

self_agreement.note: the same window shown twice, at least a quarter of the queue apart: how often the human gave the same interesting / not answer. No model can be expected to agree with the human more than the human agrees with themself

i_later_block.confusion_note: rows: the blind human · columns: the model (its cluster through the frozen mapping)

null.rule: the human's answers permuted against the model's fixed calls

reweighted.note: each labelled window weighted by its stratum's windows / the windows drawn from it (exam × predicted cluster): an estimate for every test window of this exam, not only the sample, which over-represents rare clusters on purpose

rows.how_fed: the raw window as it is: its n samples → an n × n GASF image, resized to 224 × 224 by the network's own transform; nothing resampled. P(interesting) = class 0, as the window matrix reads it
rows.embedding: a Gramian field of the window's own samples: no fixed-sample parameter, but each pixel covers n / 224 samples
rows.contamination: very likely trained on M2_aug's 2025–26 manual labels (no provenance was recorded): a blind window that overlaps one of those labels is not unseen for it. 'all' scores every blind-labelled window; 'no earlier label' only the windows that overlap no earlier human label (every M2_concat_fs1 window qualifies)
